title: Cells to Organisms: Levels of Organisation
summary: Cells form tissues, tissues form organs, organs form organ systems, and systems make an organism.

ib.note: Organ systems are studied in detail in Unit 5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 2: The Invisible Living World: Beyond Our Naked Eye

objectives: I can put the levels of organisation in order: cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism.
I can give plant and animal examples of each level.
I can explain why organs need several different tissues.
misconceptions: An organ is made of just one type of cell.
